name: page-form-session-owner-closeout
title: Remove page_key form-session recovery from live page context
description: Retire page_key-based form-session lookup from runtime snapshots and form actions so live page workflow state is owned only by explicit surface/session identity.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-22 audit follow-up identified that the live connector handshake was already keyed by explicit page_session_id, but frontend runtime snapshot/form resolution still fell back through page_key-backed form-session lookups. 2026-04-22 closeout completed in commit `2ef2316e2`: `runtime-bridge-snapshot.ts` and `runtime-bridge-form-actions.ts` now resolve live form state only from explicit surface/session identity (with final tracker active-session fallback), and runtime-bridge regression coverage asserts that page_key lookup helpers are no longer part of the live page workflow path. The tracker may still retain pageKey mappings for local CRUD ownership helpers, but live runtime page context/actions no longer use page_key as a form-session recovery owner.
